description: Temurin SBOM validation stage parameters. This stage clones temurin-build and delegates to tooling/validateSBOM.sh. The temurin-build repo and branch are read from pipeline-config.json (.repoDefaults.buildRepoUrl / .repoDefaults.buildRef).

parameterGroups.name: Source Control
parameterGroups.description: Refs that pin exactly what source is checked out for this stage. Leave empty to use the defaults defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: BUILD_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the temurin-build repository. Empty = default defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.
